title: Master 3.103 Strange stats
body:
I installed master v3103 over dev A and reset the database on the 10th of August.
Today is the 13th.
The stats are very strange with data about the 9th, stats for the 13th (day just starting) and a double line for the 12th... (The 100% TIR line is incorrect for the 9th and 12th).
